class.name: qar_rviz_streaming/QarStreamingPanel
class.description: Qar Streaming control panel. Connect to the QarOS runtime, invite peers, start/stop per-peer stereo streams, choose stream resolution and FPS, stream RViz dock panels and ROS topics as AR GUI panels, pick points and poses in the AR scene, and view live render diagnostics for the RViz DisplayContext and Ogre scene. There is no peer authorization UI; the peer id only identifies and routes a stream.
